text:
aisha: Quick sync — final GA readiness checklist: SLA, docs, oncall, monitoring, pricing. Need signoff by EOD Fri. @ben @carmen @diego @elena @farah
ben: On infra: latency SLOs verified on testbed. p95 ≈ 70ms, p99 ≈ 420ms under usual load. We need clear SLA wording for burst/backfill behavior.
carmen: SRE: can commit to 99.9% uptime for the API surface. We need deploy blackout windows called out in the SLA and a runbook for degraded-KV-cache fallback.
dicego: Docs: draft GA guide (overview, quickstart, runbooks, rollback) is ~80% done. Will add examples and pricing table. Blocker: final legal SLA text.
elena: Support: tier1 triage playbook ready. Need a list of known limitations + canned replies. Can staff weekend rota if release date is locked.
farah: FinOps: pricing thresholds need mapping to token tiers and quota behavior. Recommend soft-limits + auto-notify at 80% usage and a billing safety cap.
aisha: Decision check — SLA numeric targets proposal: 99.9% uptime, p95 < 120ms, p99 < 500ms. Agree? @ben
ben: Agree on targets. For p99 we should footnote cross-region failovers: p99 target applies to single-region capacity; fallback behavior is an exception in SLA section 3.
carmen: Also add error budget burn policy: automated alert to oncall at 25% daily burn, critical page at 50% burn.
dicego: I'll include appendix "SLA exceptions and fallbacks" and slot final text when Legal shares wording. ETA: Fri 12:00 PST.
aisha: Oncall staffing: Carmen to propose weekend rota for first 2 weeks post-GA. Elena to provide tier1 staffing plan and escalation matrix.
carmen: Proposing pager schedule: primary SRE + backup oncall-eng. Will post proposed schedule in #eng-oncall by EOD tomorrow.
elena: Support staffing: default Mon–Fri 09:00–18:00. For week-1 surge we can add two extra L2 shifts. Need comms plan + knowledge base links.
aisha: Monitoring & alerts: every alert must include a runbook link and severity tag. @ben can you attach runbook_url to alert payloads?
ben: Yes — will add runbook_url field. Also enabling synthetic checks every 2m for /health, /predict and a downstream latency monitor.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: CI smoke passed. Canary at 10% traffic for 2h and healthy so far.
aisha: Rollout policy: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 2-hour stability gates. Auto-rollback on >1% absolute error increase OR p95 > 2x baseline.
farah: Billing controls: enforce default burst cap to protect customers from runaway costs; enterprise can opt-in to higher cap with signed terms. Need explicit copy in pricing doc.
dicego: Adding "cost-control" subsection to docs with quota setup and team alerts. Docs snippet: ```- Overview
- SLA
- Pricing & quotas
- Runbooks
- Quickstart
- Rollback```
aisha: Open action items — Legal SLA text (owner: Legal, @shira), Billing cap copy (owner: Farah), Final doc publish (owner: Diego). Deadline: EOD Fri.
ben: Technical task: implement graceful-degradation fallback and add tests to the harness. I'll open PR by Thu EOD.
carmen: Prepare incident runbook and schedule drills for week 2 after GA. Will link runbook in the alert payloads.
elena: :thumbsup: I'll draft canned responses + escalation tree and share with Diego for inclusion in docs.
aisha: I'll consolidate this into the GA checklist and ping execs tomorrow morning. If no objections, I'll lock launch target for Monday 14:30 UTC.
